title: Priority Blockers: Welfare and Incentives in Matching under General Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2609.25481v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Institutions often face constraints richer than a single capacity. Protecting the priority of a student who cannot be accommodated may then block a lower-priority student who fits. We introduce COP-and-Choose, a cumulative offer process followed by a choice step, and show that its greedy version, which skips such blockers, leaves no student worse off than any fair matching or Knapsack Deferred Acceptance (KDA). Greedy is the unique consistent rule preserving this guarantee. With substitutability and size monotonicity at every school, greedy is strategy-proof and Pareto-undominated among strategy-proof mechanisms. If either fails at a school, one additional capacity-one school yields a market where, under every proposal order, greedy is manipulable and no strategy-proof mechanism weakly Pareto dominates it. translated_title: 优先级阻塞者：一般约束下匹配中的福利与激励
translated_abstract: 机构常常面临比单一容量更丰富的约束。此时，保护一名无法被安置的学生的优先级可能会阻塞一名符合条件但优先级较低的学生。我们提出了COP-and-Choose机制，即在累积报价过程之后进行一个选择步骤，并证明其贪婪版本——跳过此类阻塞者——不会使任何学生的境况比任何公平匹配或背包延迟接受算法（KDA）更差。贪婪规则是唯一能保持这一保证的一致性规则。当每所学校都满足可替代性和规模单调性时，贪婪规则是防策略操纵的，并且在所有防策略操纵机制中不被帕累托支配。如果某所学校不满足其中任一条件，则只需增加一所容量为一的学校，即可构造出一个市场，在该市场中，无论提案顺序如何，贪婪规则都是可操纵的，且没有任何防策略操纵机制能弱帕累托支配它。在一个基于模拟偏好的三资源难民安置校准实验中，相对于KDA，19%至33%的家庭获得改善，……
tldr: 本文提出COP-and-Choose机制，其贪婪版本在一般约束匹配中保证不劣于任何公平匹配或KDA，并在满足可替代性与规模单调性时兼具防操纵性与策略机制中的帕累托优势。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes COP-and-Choose, whose greedy variant guarantees no student is worse off than under any fair matching or KDA in matching under general constraints, and achieves strategy-proofness and Pareto-undomination among strategy-proof mechanisms when substitutability and size monotonicity hold.
